PluginData.Author: Cheezecake
PluginData.Tooltip: Early release: fly with joysticks, a separate stick and throttle included, on native Linux.
PluginData.Description:
EARLY RELEASE, not yet tried with a physical HOTAS. Fly with joysticks on native Linux (Interim, no Proton), flat or in VR with Cheezecake's SE VR.
- Every joystick, throttle and pedal set at once, read straight from the kernel; devices can come and go while the game runs - Axes add to the keyboard, mouse and VR hands: move, pitch, yaw, roll and the camera - Buttons and hats: fire, target lock, lights, dampeners, handbrake, power, parking, wheel jump, brakes, toolbar - Wheels: steering, drive force by throttle, and a brake lever (needs the plugin on the server for drive force) - Programmable blocks named [AnalogThrottle] get wolfe's AnalogThrottle format, so his scripts work unchanged
Set up binds under Plugin settings. On Windows, use ananace's Analog Grid Control instead.
Bug reports: https://github.com/cheezecake-dev/CheezecakeLinuxHotas
